_comment: What gets installed, grouped by what you actually do on this machine.
kind: plugin   enabled by writing settings.json (marketplace + enabledPlugins)
kind: craftkit same, but from this repo's own marketplace
kind: skill    cloned from upstream at a pinned commit, into ~/.claude/skills
kind: manual   an installer, run with its version or commit pinned
Nothing third-party is vendored here. Most of these carry no licence file,
which under copyright means the author kept every right, so the installer
clones from each upstream instead of shipping a copy.
`commit` pins what gets installed. These run with full agent permissions, so
a floating default branch means today's audit says nothing about tomorrow's
install. Refresh with `craftkit --update-pins`, which resolves each HEAD and
writes it back so the change is a reviewable diff. `--latest` ignores pins on
purpose. Plugins (kind: plugin/craftkit) cannot be pinned from here - Claude
Code fetches those itself from the marketplace.

lean-ctx.note: Ships as a platform binary, not an npm package. The upstream installer is a shell script, so craftkit resolves the release, verifies the published SHA256 and unpacks it - which works on Windows and checks what it downloaded.
